Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1791. Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary to compound_structures. Filter to standard_type IC50, standard_relation exactly '=', and pchembl_value not null. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows. Do not deduplicate.
